headline:
Quality pullback,
growth still intact
chart_note: 10-day range: $1696.16 - $1883.12, down almost 10% over the window - closed down 2.2% today alone.
why_today: Closed down 2.2% today, extending a 10-day pullback - no company-specific news, revenue and earnings still growing double digits YoY.
pro_1: Revenue up 21% and earnings up 29% YoY - the EUV lithography monopoly keeps compounding
pro_2: Analyst sentiment overwhelmingly positive (40 Buy/Strong Buy vs. 3 Hold, 1 Sell) despite the recent dip
con_1: Down almost 10% in 10 days - worth checking whether this is a pause or the start of a bigger move
con_2: Still not cheap at 59x trailing earnings, even after the pullback
